title: CarbonPlan 4D climate demo (tavg/prec monthly climatology)
description:
CarbonPlan ndpyramid demo: a Zarr V2, consolidated, carbonplan/ndpyramid "multiscales" (reduce-type) pyramid of 6 levels (path "0" coarsest 128x128 .. "5" finest 4096x4096), each level a `<level>/climate` array with dims [band, month, y, x] in EPSG:3857 (WGS 84 / Pseudo-Mercator), zlib-compressed float32, fill value 9.969209968386869e+36. The `band` coordinate is a 2-element string array; decoding the level-0 chunk confirms the order is `["tavg", "prec"]` (band 0 = mean monthly temperature, band 1 = monthly precipitation) -- this is a demo/example dataset with no documented units, so the render below assumes tavg is already in degrees Celsius, the common CarbonPlan demo convention. License is unclear for this GCS demo bucket; linked via the CarbonPlan maps project.

CORRECTION (browser run, 2026-11): every level is chunked `[2, 12, n, n]`, so one chunk holds all 12 months. The map draws one month, so a tile read fetches 12 times the data it draws -- past the browser's amplification limit of 8. The store is chunked for a monthly animation, not for a map.

Expected browser outcome: refused by the chunk-amplification guard (12x on the month axis), with the chunk-shape notice.

band.description: band 0 = tavg (mean monthly temperature), band 1 = prec (monthly precipitation), read from the band coordinate array

climate.description: Finest level (path "5"); chunks equal the full array at each level (one chunk per level, ndpyramid style). Coarser levels 0-4 have shape/chunks [2,12,128*2^n,128*2^n].

data.title: CarbonPlan 4D demo climate pyramid (Zarr V2, consolidated, EPSG:3857)
data.description: ndpyramid "reduce" multiscales, levels "0".."5" (6 levels), each level a single `<level>/climate` array covering the full Web Mercator extent at increasing resolution.
